categories.title: Direction and movement
categories.description: Arrows and chevrons that move through pages, steps, lists and sections.

categories.title: Actions
categories.description: Things a person does to content: add, remove, copy, upload, search and undo.

categories.title: Status and feedback
categories.description: The state of a message, a task or a case, always shown together with words.

categories.title: Interface controls
categories.description: Menus, settings, views, visibility and media controls in an interface.

categories.title: Text editing
categories.description: Formatting, lists, alignment, links and code in the rich text editor.

categories.title: Tables and data
categories.description: Tables, the table tools of the editor, and charts of figures.

categories.title: Documents and files
categories.description: Documents, forms, attachments, images, certificates and folders.

categories.title: Communication
categories.description: Email, phone, chat, notifications, news and sending a message.

categories.title: People and identity
categories.description: People, accounts, identification, signing in and verified identity.

categories.title: Time and date
categories.description: Dates, times, appointments, time limits and history.

categories.title: Maps and places
categories.description: Maps, places, routes, map navigation and public buildings.

categories.title: Money and payments
categories.description: Paying, invoices, receipts and benefits paid out.

categories.title: Care, health and education
categories.description: Welfare services: health care, social care, schools and work.

categories.title: Mobility and environment
categories.description: Transport, streets, waste, water, energy and nature.

categories.title: Safety, law and civic life
categories.description: Security, privacy, emergencies, law and elections.

categories.title: Leisure, culture and community
categories.description: Clubs, bookings, sports places, trails and culture that a municipality runs or funds.

categories.title: Language and access
categories.description: Language, accessibility, display settings, reading aloud and captions.

categories.title: Social media
categories.description: Marks of social networks, always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

categories.title: Service marks
categories.description: Marks of payment, e-identification and device-standard services, always shown with the service's name, never the only text.

categories.title: Home and living
categories.description: The home, its rooms, furniture and tools: what a resident repairs, renovates or applies for.

categories.title: Food and clothing
categories.description: What people eat, wear and buy for daily life: meals, groceries and clothes.

icons.name: arrow-back
icons.meaning: Go back: an arrow with a shaft pointing to the inline start.

icons.name: arrow-forward
icons.meaning: Go on, start or continue: an arrow with a shaft pointing to the inline end.

icons.name: chevron-back
icons.meaning: Previous, towards the inline start: a chevron pointing back.

icons.name: chevron-down
icons.meaning: Open or show what is below: a chevron pointing down.

icons.name: chevron-forward
icons.meaning: Next, towards the inline end: a chevron pointing forward.

icons.name: chevron-up
icons.meaning: Close or show what is above: a chevron pointing up.

icons.name: collapse-all
icons.meaning: Close every section at once: two chevrons pointing towards each other.

icons.name: expand-all
icons.meaning: Open every section at once: two chevrons pointing away from each other.

icons.name: external
icons.meaning: Opens somewhere else: an arrow leaving an open frame at its inline-end top.

icons.name: first
icons.meaning: Go to the first page or item: a chevron pointing back against a bar.

icons.name: last
icons.meaning: Go to the last page or item: a chevron pointing forward against a bar.

icons.name: refresh
icons.meaning: Load again or try again: a circular arrow.

icons.name: add
icons.meaning: Add or add another: a plus.

icons.name: check
icons.meaning: Selected or completed: a check mark.

icons.name: close
icons.meaning: Close, dismiss or clear: two crossed diagonal strokes.

icons.name: copy
icons.meaning: Copy to the clipboard: two equal sheets, one in front of the other.

icons.name: cut
icons.meaning: Cut to the clipboard: open scissors.

icons.name: delete
icons.meaning: Delete for good: a waste bin with a lid and a handle.

icons.name: download
icons.meaning: Save a file to the device: an arrow going down into an open tray.

icons.name: edit
icons.meaning: Change something: a pencil at 45 degrees, tip down.

icons.name: paste
icons.meaning: Paste from the clipboard: a board with a clip over its top edge.

icons.name: print
icons.meaning: Print: a printer with a sheet coming out of it.

icons.name: redo
icons.meaning: Redo the change: a U-turn arrow with its head at the inline end.

icons.name: remove
icons.meaning: Remove one or decrease: a minus.

icons.name: search
icons.meaning: Search: a magnifying glass, its handle to the lower right.

icons.name: share
icons.meaning: Share with others: three small rings joined in a V by two lines.

icons.name: undo
icons.meaning: Undo the last change: a U-turn arrow with its head at the inline start.

icons.name: upload
icons.meaning: Send a file from the device: an arrow rising out of an open tray.

icons.name: attention
icons.meaning: Needs your action: an exclamation mark, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.attention

icons.name: blocked
icons.meaning: Blocked or not allowed: a barrier, a bar on two posts, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.blocked

icons.name: error
icons.meaning: Something is wrong: an octagon with a small cross.
icons.label: icons.error

icons.name: help
icons.meaning: Help and support: a lifebuoy ring with four bands, never a question mark; glyph only with no container (the ring is the object), always with words.
icons.label: icons.help

icons.name: spinner
icons.meaning: A three-quarter arc that crawls when the class kv-animate-spinner is added; glyph only, always with words.
icons.label: icons.spinner

icons.name: info
icons.meaning: Information, good to know: a rounded square with a dot over a stem.
icons.label: icons.info

icons.name: new
icons.meaning: New or recently added: a four-pointed sparkle, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.new

icons.name: pending
icons.meaning: Waiting, not started yet: an hourglass, glyph only with no container, always with words.
icons.label: icons.pending

icons.name: success
icons.meaning: Success or done: a circle with a check mark.
icons.label: icons.success

icons.name: warning
icons.meaning: Take care: a triangle with an exclamation mark.
icons.label: icons.warning

icons.name: drag-handle
icons.meaning: Move by dragging: six large dots in two columns of three.

icons.name: eye
icons.meaning: Show a hidden value: an open eye.

icons.name: eye-off
icons.meaning: Hide a shown value: an open eye with a slash broken around the pupil.

icons.name: filter
icons.meaning: Filter the results: a funnel with its stem cut at 45 degrees.

icons.name: fullscreen
icons.meaning: Enter full screen: four corner marks at the square keyline.

icons.name: fullscreen-exit
icons.meaning: Leave full screen: four corner marks turned inwards.

icons.name: lock
icons.meaning: Locked or secure: a closed padlock.
icons.label: icons.lock

icons.name: menu
icons.meaning: Open the navigation menu: three equal horizontal lines.
icons.label: icons.menu

icons.name: more
icons.meaning: More actions or options: three large dots in a row.

icons.name: more-vertical
icons.meaning: More actions for one row: three large dots stacked.

icons.name: pause
icons.meaning: Pause playback: two upright bars.

icons.name: play
icons.meaning: Start or resume playback: a triangle pointing right, which follows the media, not the script.

icons.name: settings
icons.meaning: Settings: a gear with eight teeth around a hub.

icons.name: sort
icons.meaning: Sortable, not sorted yet: an up arrow and a down arrow side by side.

icons.name: stop
icons.meaning: Stop playback: a rounded square.

icons.name: unlock
icons.meaning: Unlocked: a padlock with its shackle open.
icons.label: icons.unlock

icons.name: view-grid
icons.meaning: Show as a grid: four rounded tiles, two by two.

icons.name: align-center
icons.meaning: Centre the text: four lines, long and short, centred.

icons.name: align-end
icons.meaning: Align the text to the end: four lines flush to the inline end.

icons.name: align-start
icons.meaning: Align the text to the start: four lines flush to the inline start.

icons.name: bold
icons.meaning: Make text bold: the letter B.

icons.name: bullet-list
icons.meaning: A bulleted list: three large dots at the inline start, each with a text line.

icons.name: checklist
icons.meaning: A list of tasks to tick: two rows, each a small check and a text line.

icons.name: clear-formatting
icons.meaning: Remove all formatting: a heavy bar (a formatted run) with a small cross.

icons.name: code
icons.meaning: Inline code: a pair of angle brackets.

icons.name: code-block
icons.meaning: A block of code: small angle brackets inside a landscape frame.

icons.name: heading-1
icons.meaning: A level 1 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 1.

icons.name: heading-2
icons.meaning: A level 2 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 2.

icons.name: heading-3
icons.meaning: A level 3 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 3.

icons.name: heading-4
icons.meaning: A level 4 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 4.

icons.name: heading-5
icons.meaning: A level 5 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 5.

icons.name: heading-6
icons.meaning: A level 6 heading: the letter H followed by the numeral 6.

icons.name: highlight
icons.meaning: Highlight text: a highlighter pen at 45 degrees over a baseline.

icons.name: indent
icons.meaning: Increase the indent: four lines, the middle two moved in, a small chevron to the end.

icons.name: italic
icons.meaning: Make text italic: the letter I with serifs, leaning forward.

icons.name: justify
icons.meaning: Justify the text: four equal full-width lines.

icons.name: link
icons.meaning: A link: two chain links on the 45 degree axis.

icons.name: link-off
icons.meaning: Remove a link: the outer halves of two chain links, parted by a slash.

icons.name: numbered-list
icons.meaning: A numbered list: rows marked with one, two and three tally ticks.

icons.name: outdent
icons.meaning: Decrease the indent: as indent, the chevron pointing to the inline start.

icons.name: quote
icons.meaning: A quotation block: a bar at the inline start beside three text lines.

icons.name: strike
icons.meaning: Strike text through: the letter S with a rule through it.

icons.name: text-color
icons.meaning: Change the colour of text: an ink drop over a baseline.

icons.name: underline
icons.meaning: Underline text: the letter U with a rule beneath it.

icons.name: chart-bar

icons.name: chart-line

icons.meaning: A school as a place: a building with two low wings, a central gable with a round clock and a door; not a graduation cap.
icons.label: icons.school

icons.name: preschool
icons.meaning: Preschool and early childhood education: the house with a small slide inside.
icons.label: icons.preschool

icons.name: university
icons.meaning: Higher education: a graduation cap.
icons.label: icons.university

icons.name: ambulance
icons.meaning: An ambulance: a box van seen from the side with a roof beacon and a pulse band along the side; no cross.
icons.label: icons.ambulance

icons.name: police
icons.meaning: The police: a patrol car seen from the side with a roof light bar; no badge, star, insignia or text.
icons.label: icons.police

icons.name: firetruck
icons.meaning: The fire brigade: a fire engine seen from the side with a ladder.
icons.label: icons.firetruck

icons.name: tram
icons.meaning: A tram: a tram seen from the front with its overhead wire.
icons.label: icons.tram

icons.name: subway
icons.meaning: An underground railway: a train in a tunnel mouth; no letter signs.
icons.label: icons.subway

icons.name: government
icons.meaning: The state, as opposed to the municipality: a building with a pediment and columns.
icons.label: icons.government

icons.name: wheelchair
icons.meaning: A wheelchair as an object, not a person in it: a big wheel, a back with a push handle, a seat, a footrest and a small front wheel.
icons.label: icons.wheelchair

icons.name: gender-male
icons.meaning: Male: the standard circle with an arrow out to the upper right.

icons.name: gender-female
icons.meaning: Female: the standard circle with a cross below it.

icons.name: gender-non-binary
icons.meaning: Non-binary: a ring with a stem up to the centre of a small cross made of two 45 degree strokes.

icons.name: gender-fluid
icons.meaning: Gender fluid: a circle with a male arrow and a female cross joined.

icons.name: tag
icons.meaning: A tag or label attached to something: a tag with a hole.

icons.name: hashtag
icons.meaning: A hashtag topic: two vertical and two horizontal strokes crossing.

icons.name: direct-message
icons.meaning: A private message to one person: a speech bubble with a single figure.

icons.name: pin-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a place or point: the pin with the badge minus.

icons.name: cash
icons.meaning: Cash: a banknote with a ring in the middle; no currency symbol or numeral.
icons.label: icons.cash

icons.name: wallet
icons.meaning: A wallet: a folded billfold with a clasp; not a card.
icons.label: icons.wallet

icons.name: theatre
icons.meaning: A theatre or stage: a stage with a scalloped pelmet, tied-back curtains and a floor line.
icons.label: icons.theatre

icons.name: translate
icons.meaning: Translate text from one language to another: two overlapping panels with a one-way arrow beneath, from the back panel to the front one; no glyphs.

icons.name: view-columns
icons.meaning: Show as columns: a frame divided by vertical rules.

icons.name: skip-next
icons.meaning: Skip to the next item in media: a play triangle against a bar.

icons.name: skip-previous
icons.meaning: Back to the previous item in media: a play triangle against a bar, the mirror of skip-next.

icons.name: person-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a person: the person with the badge minus.

icons.name: calendar-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a date or cancel a booking: the calendar with the badge minus.

icons.name: document-add
icons.meaning: Add a document: the document with the badge plus; no text line.

icons.name: document-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a document: the document with the badge minus; no text line.

icons.name: folder-add
icons.meaning: Add a folder or open a case: the folder with the badge plus.

icons.name: folder-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a folder or case: the folder with the badge minus.

icons.name: mail-add
icons.meaning: Subscribe by email: the envelope with the badge plus.

icons.name: mail-remove
icons.meaning: Unsubscribe from email: the envelope with the badge minus.

icons.name: mail-off
icons.meaning: Email is off or unavailable: the envelope with the kit slash.

icons.name: video-call-off
icons.meaning: Video is off: the video camera with the kit slash.

icons.name: mobile-off
icons.meaning: The mobile phone is off or unavailable: the phone with the kit slash.

icons.name: image-add
icons.meaning: Add an image: the image frame with its peak and the badge plus; no sun.

icons.name: image-remove
icons.meaning: Remove an image: the image frame with its peak and the badge minus; no sun.

icons.name: attachment-remove
icons.meaning: Remove an attachment: the paper clip with the badge minus.

icons.name: zoom-in
icons.meaning: Zoom in, show closer: a magnifying glass with a plus inside.

icons.name: zoom-out
icons.meaning: Zoom out, show more of the whole: a magnifying glass with a minus inside.

icons.name: expand
icons.meaning: Open one section: a chevron pointing down inside a square, the single-item counterpart of expand-all.

icons.name: collapse
icons.meaning: Close one section: a chevron pointing up inside a square, the single-item counterpart of collapse-all.

icons.name: pin-off
icons.meaning: A place or point is hidden or unpinned: the pin with the kit slash, its outline broken around the slash and its hole dropped.

icons.name: sort-ascending
icons.meaning: Sorted ascending, smallest first: the sort family's up arrow beside three bars that grow from top to bottom.

icons.name: sort-descending
icons.meaning: Sorted descending, largest first: the sort family's down arrow beside three bars that shrink from top to bottom.

icons.name: filter-off
icons.meaning: Clear the filters, or no filter applied: the funnel shifted 2 up, opened on its inline-end side, with the badge cross.

icons.name: attachment-add
icons.meaning: Add an attachment: the paper clip with the badge plus.

icons.name: hang-up
icons.meaning: End a call: the telephone handset laid down, ear and mouth pieces turned down.

icons.name: chat-off
icons.meaning: Chat is off or unavailable: the speech bubble with the kit slash.

icons.name: save
icons.meaning: Save your work or a draft: a diskette with a shutter and a label.

icons.name: heart
icons.meaning: Mark something as a favourite: an outline heart, two round lobes and a point.

icons.name: star
icons.meaning: A rating or a highlighted item: an outline five-pointed star.

icons.name: bookmark
icons.meaning: Keep a page or item to come back to later: a bookmark ribbon with a notched end.

icons.name: like
icons.meaning: Like or find helpful: a raised thumb with a cuff, no page behind it. A hand gesture, rude in some cultures; always with words.

icons.name: x
icons.meaning: The mark of the X social network (formerly Twitter): a simplified letter X drawn as a hollow slanted band crossed by a thin stroke that passes behind it, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text. Not a close or remove icon: that is `close`.

icons.name: facebook
icons.meaning: The mark of the Facebook social network: a simplified lower-case f inside a circle, its stem running down into the circle's bottom edge, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: instagram
icons.meaning: The mark of the Instagram photo network: a simplified camera outline, a rounded square with a ring in the centre and a dot at the upper end corner, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: linkedin
icons.meaning: The mark of the LinkedIn professional network: a simplified lower-case "in" inside a rounded square, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: youtube
icons.meaning: The mark of the YouTube video network: a simplified wide rounded frame with a play triangle inside, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: tiktok
icons.meaning: The mark of the TikTok video network: a simplified outline of a thick musical note with a hollow head and a hooked flag. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: mastodon
icons.meaning: The mark of the Mastodon social network: a simplified speech bubble with a lower lip on the left and the network's m inside. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: bluesky
icons.meaning: The mark of the Bluesky social network: a simplified butterfly outline in one stroke. A trademark of its owner; always shown with the network's name, never as the only link text.

icons.name: rss
icons.meaning: A web feed (RSS or Atom) to subscribe to: a dot with two quarter arcs spreading from it.
icons.label: icons.rss

icons.name: settings-6
icons.meaning: Settings, a variant of `settings`: a gear with six teeth around a hub (the same meaning, a lighter gear for consumers who prefer it).

icons.name: database-add
icons.meaning: Add a database or dataset: the database cylinder with the badge plus.

icons.name: database-remove
icons.meaning: Remove a database or dataset: the database cylinder with the badge minus.

icons.name: bankid
icons.meaning: The mark of the BankID e-identification service (Sweden, Norway): a simplified upright capital "B" inside a rounded square, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner and not the official logo; always shown with the service's name, never as the only text, and never in place of the official button or logo where the owner requires it.

icons.name: two-factor
icons.meaning: Two-step sign-in: a phone (something you have) with a small key (something you know) at its lower inline-end corner.

icons.name: visa
icons.meaning: The mark of the Visa card network: a simplified V with a short lead-in stroke on a card plate, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner and not the official logo; always shown with the service's name, never as the only text, and never in place of the official logo where the owner requires it.

icons.name: mastercard
icons.meaning: The mark of the Mastercard card network: two overlapping circles side by side, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner and not the official logo; always shown with the service's name, never as the only text, and never in place of the official logo where the owner requires it.

icons.name: klarna
icons.meaning: The mark of the Klarna payment service: a simplified K with a curved upper arm and a full stop on a card plate, in one stroke. A trademark of its owner and not the official logo; always shown with the service's name, never as the only text, and never in place of the official logo where the owner requires it.

icons.name: digital-signage
icons.meaning: A public information screen in a hall, at a stop or in a library: a landscape screen with two text lines on a pole with a foot.

icons.name: ear
icons.meaning: Hearing: an ear in profile with the inner arc of the helix. No slash, no waves.

icons.name: headphones
icons.meaning: Listen with headphones (an audio guide or audio description): a headband over two ear cups.

icons.name: volume
icons.meaning: Sound on or volume: a speaker with two sound arcs.

icons.name: volume-off
icons.meaning: Sound off (muted): the speaker of volume with a cross where the sound arcs were.

icons.name: microphone
icons.meaning: Speak or record: a microphone in a holder on a stand.

icons.name: microphone-off
icons.meaning: Microphone off: the microphone with the kit slash.

icons.name: hearing-loop
icons.meaning: A hearing (induction) loop is available: an ear in a rounded square. It is the public sign without its letter T, so always show it with words.

icons.name: sign-language
icons.meaning: Sign language: an open hand, fingers together, thumb out. It isn't a sign from any one sign language.

icons.name: multilingual
icons.meaning: Available in several languages: two overlapping speech bubbles, each with a different mark (a line and a dot) and no letters. For changing language use language (the globe).

icons.name: subscription
icons.meaning: A subscription or recurring payment: a bank card with a small circular arrow in the badge place.

icons.name: renew
icons.meaning: Renew a permit, licence, loan or membership: a document with a small circular arrow in the badge place.

icons.name: membership
icons.meaning: Membership: a member card with a round emblem and two lines. id-card has a portrait instead.

icons.name: newsletter
icons.meaning: Newsletter: a letter with a text line rising out of an open envelope. mail is the closed envelope.

icons.name: cancel-subscription
icons.meaning: Cancel a subscription or recurring payment: the card of subscription with the badge × in place of the circular arrow.

icons.name: electric-car
icons.meaning: An electric car: the car seen from the front with a lightning bolt across its body.

icons.name: ev-charging
icons.meaning: A place to charge an electric car: a charging post with a lightning bolt and a cable hanging from its side.

icons.name: parking
icons.meaning: Parking: the car seen from the front under a wide roof. No letter P.

icons.name: fuel
icons.meaning: Fuel or a filling station: a pump with a display window and a hose hanging from its side.

icons.name: taxi
icons.meaning: A taxi: the car seen from the front with a sign on its roof; no text on the sign.

icons.name: truck
icons.meaning: A truck: a tall cargo box behind a lower cab, seen from the side.

icons.name: motorcycle
icons.meaning: A motorcycle seen from the side: two wheels, a seat and tank line running into the front fork.

icons.name: driving-licence
icons.meaning: A driving licence: a card with a steering wheel; distinct from id-card (portrait and lines).

icons.name: hammer
icons.meaning: A hammer: a handle at 45° with a head across its end.

icons.name: screwdriver
icons.meaning: A screwdriver: a round-ended handle with a long thin shaft at 45°.

icons.name: drill
icons.meaning: A power drill seen from the side: body, chuck and a bit pointing right, a grip below.

icons.name: saw
icons.meaning: A hand saw at 45°: a handle and a blade with three large teeth.

icons.name: toolbox
icons.meaning: Tools, or home repair as a topic: a box with a wide handle and a latch on its lid line; distinct from job (briefcase).

icons.name: paint-roller
icons.meaning: Painting and decorating: a paint roller with its frame and handle.

icons.name: suitcase
icons.meaning: Travel or luggage: an upright rolling suitcase with a pull handle and wheels.

icons.name: plane
icons.meaning: Air travel, a flight or an airport: an airliner seen from above, nose up.

icons.name: passport
icons.meaning: A passport or travel document: a booklet with a plain globe mark, no national emblem.

icons.name: hotel
icons.meaning: A place to stay overnight: a bed under a wide roof.

icons.name: tent
icons.meaning: Camping or a campsite: a ridge tent with crossed poles and an open door.

icons.name: boarding-pass
icons.meaning: A boarding pass or flight ticket: the notched ticket with a small plane.

icons.name: shirt
icons.meaning: Clothes, or a shirt: a plain short-sleeved T-shirt.

icons.name: trousers
icons.meaning: Trousers: a pair of long trousers with a waistband.

icons.name: jacket
icons.meaning: A jacket or coat: a long-sleeved jacket with a zip down the front.

icons.name: shoe
icons.meaning: Shoes or footwear: a low shoe seen from the side.

icons.name: hat
icons.meaning: A hat or headwear: a plain round-crowned hat with a band and a brim.

icons.name: clothes-hanger
icons.meaning: A clothes hanger, or a cloakroom: a hanger with a hook.

icons.name: laundry
icons.meaning: Laundry or a laundry room: a T-shirt pegged on a clothesline.

icons.name: tablet
icons.meaning: A tablet computer: a wide upright screen with a home dot at the foot.

icons.name: laptop
icons.meaning: A laptop computer: an open screen above a flat keyboard base.

icons.name: desktop
icons.meaning: A desktop computer or monitor: a landscape screen on a short two-legged stand with a foot.

icons.name: smartwatch
icons.meaning: A smartwatch or other wearable device: a square watch face with straps and a crown.

icons.name: wifi
icons.meaning: A wireless network (Wi-Fi): a dot with three arcs spreading upwards from it.

icons.name: bluetooth
icons.meaning: Bluetooth, the short-range wireless link between devices: a simplified original outline of the Bluetooth rune, the mark of the Bluetooth SIG.

icons.name: battery
icons.meaning: A battery or its charge level: a horizontal battery with a terminal and two level bars.

icons.name: restaurant
icons.meaning: A restaurant or a place to eat: a fork, a plate and a knife side by side.

icons.name: cooking
icons.meaning: Cooking or a kitchen: a pot with a domed lid and two side handles.

icons.name: groceries
icons.meaning: Groceries or food shopping: a shopping bag with a handle and a leaf on its face.

icons.name: cart
icons.meaning: A shopping cart, or the basket of an order: a cart with a handle, a basket and two wheels.

icons.name: bread
icons.meaning: Bread or a bakery: a domed loaf with two scored cuts.

icons.name: coffee
icons.meaning: Coffee, a hot drink or a cafe: a cup with a handle and two wisps of steam.

icons.name: vegetarian
icons.meaning: A vegetarian or plant-based meal or diet: a plain leaf with a stem and a midrib. One icon for both diets: the words must say vegetarian or vegan.

icons.name: door
icons.meaning: A door or entrance: a closed door leaf with a handle, standing on the floor line.

icons.name: window
icons.meaning: A window in a home: a frame with a cross of glazing bars, resting on a sill.

icons.name: roof
icons.meaning: The roof of a building: a thick pitched roof over the top of two walls.

icons.name: fence
icons.meaning: A fence around a plot or garden: three pointed pickets joined by two rails.

icons.name: mailbox
icons.meaning: A mailbox where post is delivered: a box with an arched front and a raised flag on a post.

icons.name: heating
icons.meaning: Heating in a home: a radiator with heat rising from it.

icons.name: plug
icons.meaning: A mains plug for an electrical appliance: two pins, a rounded body and a cable.

icons.name: lightbulb
icons.meaning: A light bulb: lighting in a home or building.

icons.name: stairs
icons.meaning: Stairs between floors: a flight of three steps seen from the side.

icons.name: elevator
icons.meaning: An elevator or lift: a cabin with an up and a down arrow, as on a lift's call panel.

icons.name: sofa
icons.meaning: A sofa in the living room: a two-seat couch with a backrest, armrests and short legs, seen from the front.

icons.name: chair
icons.meaning: A chair: a single seat with a backrest and four legs, seen from the front.

icons.name: dining-table
icons.meaning: A dining or kitchen table, the piece of furniture: a tabletop on two legs, seen from the side. Not a data table (that is `table`).

icons.name: bed
icons.meaning: A bed: a headboard, a mattress with a pillow and a footboard, seen from the side.

icons.name: wardrobe
icons.meaning: A wardrobe or cupboard: a tall cabinet with two doors, two handles and feet.

icons.name: lamp
icons.meaning: A table or floor lamp: a lampshade on a stand with a foot. For the light bulb itself use `lightbulb`, for outdoor lighting `street-light`.

icons.name: shelf
icons.meaning: A bookcase or shelf: a tall case with one shelf and books standing on both levels. For a single book use `book`, for stored records `archive`.

icons.name: bathtub
icons.meaning: A bathtub, or the bathroom: a tub on feet with a tap, seen from the side.

icons.name: fridge
icons.meaning: A fridge or freezer: a tall cabinet with a freezer door above the fridge door and one handle across the split.

icons.name: washing-machine
icons.meaning: A washing machine: a front-loader with a round porthole door, a knob and a display.

icons.name: oven
icons.meaning: An oven or cooker: an appliance with three knobs above a door window.

icons.name: dishwasher
icons.meaning: A dishwasher: an appliance with a control panel, a door handle and a plate standing in the rack. Use at 20px or larger, with words.

icons.name: vacuum-cleaner
icons.meaning: A vacuum cleaner: a canister on the floor, a hose and a wand down to the floor nozzle.

icons.name: broom
icons.meaning: Cleaning: a floor broom with a long handle and a bristled head.

icons.name: spray-bottle
icons.meaning: Cleaning products: a trigger spray bottle with a mist of drops.

icons.name: moving-box
icons.meaning: Moving and packing: a carton with a tape seam across its top and a hand hole.

icons.name: hand-truck
icons.meaning: Removals and heavy carrying: a sack truck with a wheel, carrying one box. Use at 20px or larger, with words.

icons.name: apartment
icons.meaning: An apartment or block of flats: a tall and a low residential block side by side, with windows.

icons.name: house-key
icons.meaning: Keys to a home: moving in, a key handover, a rental or a purchase. A key whose bow is a small house.

icons.name: garden
icons.meaning: Garden and plants: a seedling with two leaves in a pot.

icons.name: gamepad
icons.meaning: Video games, game consoles or online games: a plain game controller with a direction pad and two buttons.

icons.name: tv
icons.meaning: Television, a TV set or TV channels: a landscape screen with an antenna on top and two short feet.

icons.name: dice
icons.meaning: Games, board games or chance: one die showing five pips.

icons.name: streaming
icons.meaning: Streaming video or audio, a live stream or a streaming service: a play triangle between two broadcast arcs.

icons.name: camera
icons.meaning: A photo camera, taking a photo or photography: a camera body with a viewfinder hump, a lens ring and a flash dot.

icons.name: router
icons.meaning: A router, modem or broadband connection at home: a low box with two antennas and a row of three status lights.

icons.name: fiber
icons.meaning: Optical fibre or a fibre broadband connection: a cable bending into a connector, with light leaving its tip. Use at 20px or larger, with words.

icons.name: sim-card
icons.meaning: A SIM card or a mobile subscription: an upright card with one cut corner and a chip.

icons.name: paw
icons.meaning: Pets and animals: a plain paw print with four toe pads over a heel pad. Pet care, pet insurance and animal services (a dog is `dog`, a cat is `cat`).

icons.name: dog
icons.meaning: A dog: a plain head seen from the front with long hanging ears, two eyes and a nose, no breed.

icons.name: cat
icons.meaning: A cat: a plain head seen from the front with two pointed ears, two eyes and a small nose.

icons.name: mirror
icons.meaning: Beauty and personal care: a round hand mirror on a handle with a glint on the glass. Use at 20px or larger, with words.

icons.name: hair-dryer
icons.meaning: A hair dryer seen from the side: a round housing, a barrel with a flared nozzle and a grip below. Hairdressers and hair care.

icons.name: dumbbell
icons.meaning: Fitness and exercise: a dumbbell with two plates on each end of the bar (the outdoor training place is `outdoor-gym`, the indoor hall `sports-hall`).

icons.name: chalkboard
icons.meaning: Teaching and lessons: a board on a splayed easel with two lines of writing, a teacher cue without a person (learning in general is `education`, the building `school`).

icons.name: backpack
icons.meaning: A school bag or backpack seen from the front: a rounded top, a carry loop, a flap seam and a front pocket.

icons.name: glasses
icons.meaning: Eyeglasses: two round lenses, a bridge and two temples. Opticians, eyewear and eyesight (seeing in general is `eye`).

icons.name: bag
icons.meaning: A bag or handbag: a body with sloping shoulders under a round handle, no brand (a shopping bag of food is `groceries`). Use at 20px or larger, with words.

icons.name: umbrella
icons.meaning: An open umbrella with a scalloped edge and a hooked handle. Insurance and cover, or rain and weather.

icons.name: gavel
icons.meaning: A court ruling or a judge: a gavel, its head at 45° over a sound block.

icons.name: solar-panel
icons.meaning: Solar power: a tilted panel with a grid of cells on a post.

icons.name: wind-turbine
icons.meaning: Wind power: a three-blade turbine on a tower.

icons.name: meter
icons.meaning: A utility meter or its reading: a round dial, open at the bottom, with scale ticks and a needle.

icons.name: tyre
icons.meaning: A tyre, seen from a little to the side: the sidewall with its rim and the tread with three grooves.

icons.name: license-plate
icons.meaning: A vehicle's number plate: a wide plate with a plain band at one end and two plain marks, no letters or emblem. Use at 20px or larger, with words.

icons.name: scooter
icons.meaning: A kick scooter seen from the side: two small wheels, a low deck and a steering column with a handlebar.

icons.name: caravan
icons.meaning: A caravan seen from the side: a rounded box with a window, one wheel and a drawbar.

icons.name: apple
icons.meaning: An apple, or fruit in general: an apple with a stem and a leaf.

icons.name: milk
icons.meaning: Milk or dairy: a carton with a gable top and a fin, seen from a corner.

icons.name: guitar
icons.meaning: An acoustic guitar laid on the diagonal: figure-eight body, sound hole, neck and headstock. Playing an instrument, music lessons (one note alone is `music`).

icons.name: palette
icons.meaning: An artist's palette: a bean-shaped board with a thumb hole and three dots of paint. Art, painting and crafts.

icons.name: football
icons.meaning: An association football (soccer ball): a circle with a centre panel and five seams. Ball sports and clubs (the place is `sports-pitch`).

icons.name: binoculars
icons.meaning: Binoculars seen from the front: two barrels on a bridge over two lenses. Birdwatching, nature watching and viewpoints.

icons.name: sailboat
icons.meaning: A sailing boat: a hull with a mast, mainsail and jib. Sailing and leisure boating (a passenger boat is `ferry`, a quay with a boat is `harbour`).

icons.name: fishing-rod
icons.meaning: A fishing rod with a reel, and a line hanging from the tip to a hook. Fishing, angling and fishing licences.
